title: Sharjah Criterion: A Two-Stage Empirical Lunar Crescent Visibility Model
description: A data-driven two-stage logistic-regression criterion for lunar crescent visibility, derived from ICOP crescent sighting reports. The pipeline scrapes, cleans, and enriches observations with astronomical features, trains stage-1 (detectability) and stage-2 (naked-eye vs. aided) models, selects operational thresholds, and validates externally against the Alrefay et al. (2018) published tables.
